configurations.name: web-local
runtimeArgs: eval "$(pnpm exec supabase status -o env 2>/dev/null </dev/null | grep -E '^(API_URL|PUBLISHABLE_KEY|SERVICE_ROLE_KEY)=')"; NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL="$API_URL" NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY="$PUBLISHABLE_KEY" SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY="$SERVICE_ROLE_KEY" SESSION_COOKIE_SECRET=local-development-only-secret-0123456789 exec pnpm dev --port 3130
